spatial_and_color_evidence.method_note: Neighborhoods are 8-connected. Channel-wise intermediacy means the RGB value lies inside the axis-aligned range of a pair of neighboring valid class colors. The convex-segment test requires the value to lie within 1 RGB level of a segment joining two neighboring valid colors.

affected_files.conclusion: The invalid pixels do not uniformly satisfy the tested boundary/intermediacy criteria; these data alone do not support attributing every invalid value to interpolation or antialiasing.

evidence_note: Spatial and RGB intermediacy tests are evidence only; authoritative-source comparison is required to establish provenance.
